title: Utility Customer Service Voice Agent (Outages and Billing)
summary: A voice agent for power and water utilities that logs no-supply complaints, shares known outage status and answers billing queries in Hindi and regional languages.

seo.title: Utility Customer Service Voice Agent | VipraTech
seo.description: Multilingual voice agent for DISCOMs and water utilities: no-supply complaints, outage status, bill and payment queries, with safety calls escalated.

problem.intro: When a feeder trips or a storm hits, a utility's complaint lines fill within minutes with callers asking the same question in several languages. Between outages, the same agents handle bill amounts, due dates, payment confirmations and new connection status, while genuine safety calls such as a snapped conductor wait in the same queue.

pain_points.title: Outage spikes overwhelm the lines
pain_points.detail: Callers hear busy tones exactly when they most need to know whether the fault is known and being fixed.

pain_points.title: Repetitive billing questions
pain_points.detail: Bill amount, due date, last payment and duplicate bill requests take up much of agent time between outages.

pain_points.title: Language coverage gaps
pain_points.detail: Callers speak Hindi, Hinglish and regional languages and dialects that the night shift may not cover.

pain_points.title: Safety calls stuck in the queue
pain_points.detail: Reports of fallen wires, sparking poles or water on a meter board need immediate human attention, not a place in line.

solution.overview: We build a voice agent that answers on your helpline or IVR, recognises Hindi, Hinglish and the regional languages of your area, and identifies the consumer by account number or registered mobile. It checks the outage management system for known faults on the consumer's feeder or transformer and shares status, quoting a restoration time only when the control room has published one. For new faults it registers a complaint and sends the docket number by SMS or WhatsApp. For billing it reads amount, due date and payment status and can send a UPI payment link. Any mention of a safety hazard transfers the caller to a person at once.
capabilities: Identifies consumers by account number or registered mobile, with a verification step before account details
Checks known outages by feeder, transformer or area and shares only published status
Registers no-supply, low-voltage and meter complaints and returns a docket number
Reads bill amount, due date and payment status and sends a UPI payment link
Transfers immediately to a person on safety keywords such as wire down, sparking or shock
Speaks Hindi, Hinglish and the regional languages chosen for your service area

workflow.title: Answer and identify
workflow.detail: The agent detects the caller's language and identifies the consumer by account number or registered mobile.

workflow.title: Screen for safety
workflow.detail: Any mention of a fallen wire, sparking, fire or shock transfers the call to a live agent and alerts the control room.

workflow.title: Understand the request
workflow.detail: The agent classifies the intent: no supply, voltage problem, bill query, payment or new connection status.

workflow.title: Look up systems
workflow.detail: It reads outage status from the OMS or billing details from the CIS through APIs.

workflow.title: Resolve or hand over
workflow.detail: Within scope, it registers the complaint or sends the payment link; otherwise it hands over to an agent with a summary.

workflow.title: Log the call
workflow.detail: Transcript, intent, docket number and outcome are written to the CRM for reporting.

inputs: Live inbound calls from the helpline or IVR
Consumer master with account numbers and registered mobiles
Outage and restoration data from the OMS or control room

human_in_the_loop: Every safety call goes straight to a person and the control room. Callers can ask for a human at any point, and disputes about bills, assessments or disconnections are always handed over. Supervisors review a sample of transcripts each week.
integrations: Contact centre telephony or IVR over SIP
Customer information and billing system, SAP IS-U or in-house
Outage management system or control room outage feed
SMS gateway and WhatsApp Business API
guardrails: Restoration times are quoted only when the OMS or control room has published one
Safety keywords trigger immediate transfer in every supported language
Account details disclosed only after identity verification
Callers can reach a human at any time

compliance_notes: Call recordings and consumer data handled with notice and purpose limitation under the DPDP Act 2023.
Supports the complaint registration and docket records expected under state supply codes and the Electricity (Rights of Consumers) Rules, 2020.

Agent connected to OMS, billing and complaint systems in test

faqs.q: Which languages and dialects can it handle?
faqs.a: Hindi and Hinglish, plus the regional languages of your service area. We test recognition on recordings of your own callers, including local place names and terms like feeder and transformer, before the pilot goes live.

faqs.q: What if the outage system has no information about a fault?
faqs.a: The agent registers a complaint, gives the docket number and says the fault has been reported. It never invents a cause or a restoration time.

faqs.q: Can it handle a storm-day surge?
faqs.a: Yes. Capacity scales with concurrent call channels rather than staff on shift. When many calls come from one feeder, the agent can share the known status first and record new complaints only where the fault is not yet logged.

faqs.q: Does it replace our existing IVR?
faqs.a: No. It plugs into your IVR or telephony as a menu option or overflow route, so the existing menu, agent desks and reporting continue.
